title: One Letter Turns a Cargo Plane Into a Gunship

lines.text: One letter can turn a cargo plane into a gunship.
The C-130 Hercules is a cargo plane.
Put an A in front, and the AC-130 is a gunship.
H makes it a rescue aircraft. E, electronic warfare. K, a tanker.
Same airframe. One letter changes the job.
And that's just one of six parts a military aircraft name can have.
